notes:
Name your mascot, watch it gear up as you focus, emergency stops, and Mac fixes

- Name the mascot in Settings. Click it to hear how long you've been locked in today; it earns a headband at 30 minutes, a gold one at 2 hours, and a crown at 4.
- Emergency stops: end a locked session early, up to 3 times ever. Turn them off in Settings to make locked sessions unbreakable.
- Mac: typing in the appeal banner works.
- Mac: dragging the mascot no longer crashes Kairos.
- Mac: the mascot stands on top of the Dock.
